title: Trace one next-token decision
description: A toy distribution for a factual answer. Change the evidence retained in the window and the decoding controls to observe probability, entropy, candidate set, and output path together.

evidenceModes.label: Current cited source
evidenceModes.detail: A trusted, current source explicitly says the capital of France is Paris.
evidenceModes.truthNote: The source is modeled as authoritative for this teaching example, but a production system still needs source freshness and citation checks.

evidenceModes.label: Unverified conflicting text
evidenceModes.detail: A retrieved passage claims Lyon is the capital but has not been validated.
evidenceModes.truthNote: A model can assign high probability to a claim repeated in context. Retrieval is not verification.

evidenceModes.label: No supporting source
evidenceModes.detail: The request has no retained factual evidence, so the model relies on its learned prior.
evidenceModes.truthNote: A familiar answer may still be stale, misapplied, or unsupported for a production decision.

candidates.continuation: Paris. I would cite the retained source and check that it is current before treating the answer as verified.
Lyon, according to the retained text. This continuation can be confident and still be wrong because the text was not verified.
I cannot verify this from the retained evidence. Please provide a current authoritative source or allow a retrieval step.
Rome. This is a low-ranked distractor in the toy distribution and illustrates that sampling can emit a non-top candidate.
